name: Wet Summer Days
source:
Once again, as every summer, you enjoy the slow days at the farm. These are also the days you get to meet cute hot-headed Mizuki. 

Will she be a hindrance once again or will things go differently this summer?

[From [url=https://raynsan.itch.io/wet-summer-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
就像每年夏天一样，你再次享受农场里的悠闲时光。这些日子你也会遇到可爱、头脑发热的水希。

她会再次成为障碍还是今年夏天事情会有所不同？

[来自[url=https://raynsan.itch.io/wet-summer-days]Itch.io[/url]]
